title: Crayon Lifestyle Poster
summary: Redraw a photo of friends, family or pets as a lively sketchbook page: scratchy black crayon lines, a few vivid color fills taken from the photo, and optional handwritten headline and notes.
seoTitle: Crayon Sketch Lifestyle Poster Prompt (Photo to Illustration) | Image Prompt Book
seoDescription: Turn a photo into a hand-drawn crayon lifestyle poster that keeps every person, pose and prop. Adjust the accent colors and doodles, add your own headline, then copy the prompt.
inputRequirement: Requires one photo. Attach it in your image generation tool; this website does not upload or generate images. To add lettering, replace the bracketed headline and notes; leave them as they are to get no text.
howToUse: Adjust the highlighted options in the prompt.
Copy the prompt, or open it directly in ChatGPT.
Replace the bracketed headline and notes with your own words if you want lettering, attach your photo, then send.
